name: D. W. Williams
role: Northern Pacific station agent at Medora, 1886
bio: D. W. Williams was the Northern Pacific's agent at Medora from June 1886 through the end of the paper's run, and his name appeared on the railroad's time table each week. In September 1886 a Northern Pacific Express Co. official checked his books and found them in good shape. That same month he was named in the report of the Republican convention.
